items.label: LSO Live
items.note: Asyla calls for six percussionists and treated pianos; Ecstasio, its third movement, takes its pulse from techno. Adès conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in the live Barbican recording, paired with Tevot and Polaris.

items.performers: Simon Keenlyside (Prospero), Cyndia Sieden (Ariel), Ian Bostridge (Caliban), Kate Royal (Miranda), Toby Spence (Ferdinand); Orchestra and Chorus of the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden; Thomas Adès
items.label: EMI Classics / Warner Classics
items.note: Meredith Oakes recasts Shakespeare in short, rhyming lines, with Ariel written for a high soprano. The composer conducts Simon Keenlyside and Cyndia Sieden, the original Prospero and Ariel, in Covent Garden’s 2007 revival.

items.performers: Kirill Gerstein, piano; Boston Symphony Orchestra; Thomas Adès
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: A falling melody meets rising harmony in the concerto’s slow movement, before the finale brings a tumbling piano theme and a blustering clarinet. Kirill Gerstein, for whom the Boston Symphony commissioned it, plays the live première recording with Adès conducting.
